data.name: Marqooma
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'r-q-m' which means to be martyred, to die for a cause. Marqooma is a name given to a mother who has lost her child in the way of Allah. This name holds great significance in Islamic culture as it signifies sacrifice, courage, and devotion to one's faith.
